void.$description: Void — Page canvas, all section backgrounds — the true floor of the UI; every element floats above absolute black

salt.$description: Salt — All text, links, nav labels, borders, icons — the single foreground tone serving every text and UI edge function against black

ash.$description: Ash — Secondary labels, muted nav text, subdued body copy — mid-tone for visual hierarchy without introducing any hue

ghost-line.$description: Ghost Line — Grid tile borders, dividers — rgba(248,248,248,0.12) at 12% opacity; nearly invisible structural seams

veil.$description: Veil — Overlay labels, secondary text on image tiles — rgba(248,248,248,0.45) at 45% opacity for text sitting over photography

dm-sans.$description: All body copy, navigation labels, press list items, links, captions. Weight 300 across every size — the site refuses to bold anything in this family, keeping the text layer visually quiet against photography.

clashdisplay.$description: Project initials on tiles (44px weight 300, tracking -0.04em), section codes and labels (12-14px weight 300, tracking +0.05em to +0.14em), name logotype. The 44px weight-300 display setting — a nearly invisible letterform over a photograph — is the signature visual move of the portfolio.
